reviews.text: It's the best place for my dogs to make friends, be safe, and be pampered all the time. Plus, they can feed them at their mealtimes when we can't, and they let us know if they see anything strange or different about them—they're super attentive. 1000/10 for this place! I loved Mr. Pet and their entire team ♥️♥️♥️

It's great that they offer daycare and boarding services on weekends.
My dog ​​has been to daycare and comes home very happy and tired. The staff treats the dogs very well, and the customer service is equally efficient. I highly recommend it.
My dog ​​is the happiest there; he's never been around so many dogs before and he's already made lots of friends. The people who work there are super friendly and helpful.
Very well cared for
I took my two dogs to a hotel; they are different sizes and both had a wonderful time, they left very happy!
They take great care of my puppy; he always comes home happy to see Fer! The price is very reasonable.
I've been taking Lucky there for about 3 years now. He leaves happy and arrives happy. All the people who work there are very nice to all the dogs, and the service is very friendly.

If you want your pets to be happy while you're on vacation, this is an amazing place. They took great care of my dog, kept me informed every step of the way, and I appreciate that they test the dogs before leaving them there—it ensures a healthy environment. They have good protocols and everyone is very friendly. Now I'm leaving my dog ​​there for the second time, hoping it will be just as pleasant.
The best, super attentive, loving, and always on top of things: feeding, medication, walks, interaction with other dogs. Without a doubt, the best place, 1000/10
A place where my Chester has an amazing time
I left my dog ​​for 3 nights, she was very well cared for, she got a complimentary bath and everything was great

We did not have a positive experience here. We went for pin worm testing and  did arrive a bit late because of traffic. The tech was rude and asked for paperwork they didn't  tell us to bring when we made the appointment. We had to have some one else bring it as a photo wouldn't work. They were rough with our dogs as well. We did get the certificates but would likely try and find a different vet next time.
Excellent care for the dogs! My dogs left super happy. Everything is very nice, the prices are affordable, and they are very loving with the dogs.

A great place to leave your dogs for daycare! They're super attentive and loving with the pups, and they're always posting photos and videos of them. Plus, they do a fantastic job grooming my girl, giving her a bath and haircut.

They're truly the best!! I have my babies at Mr. Pet and they take excellent care of them!!

Highly recommended 1000/10 stars

I've left my dogs here at the daycare several times, and everything was fine—until I left them at the daycare and requested a bath and cut. My dogs are a Border Collie and an Alaskan Malamute. Both have long, double coats.
I sent a reference video of each cut via WhatsApp, where each video explains how to do the cuts. NOTE: These are done with scissors and AFTER the bath and blow-dry. They clipped their hair with clippers, and the day before the bath. The result was a bad coat. Not only that, but they don't know how to use the clippers, and the dogs look shorn.
Chloe was brought to me wet, unfinished, with her butt all messed up, and not a proper cut.
Very attentive Monse, very nice place and reasonable price for the value of my Siberian husky
Everything went very well with the care of my Lola, she left very happy.

The best hotel ever!!!
My dog ​​is so happy there, I love that they send photos and videos every day 🥰🥰 …

Excellent place to leave your dog, whether for the day while you work or for boarding if you're out of town. I've been taking my dog ​​there regularly for a couple of months now, and he loves it 🤍 The staff are super caring, and you can tell they give each dog their full attention. 10000/10 …
It's WOW... my furry friends love being there, they're so well looked after and cared for. They're always in touch with me and take awesome photos of all their activities.

Excellent place to take your dogs! It's actually the first time I've left my baby at a dog hotel. They sent me daily updates on how she was doing, respected her feeding schedule, and gave her treats. Of course, they eat and sleep separately in their individual rooms. I sleep peacefully knowing my dog ​​is separated from others during her rest time because she gets very anxious when there are more dogs around and can't sleep. Some dogs instinctively attack when they're eating. I love that they take such good care of them and pamper them as if they were their own.

100% recommended, good location, good prices, and excellent service.

The best stay ever!!! Our Huskies are the happiest when we take them. They've stayed many times, sometimes for up to two weeks. They send us videos of how they're doing, keep us updated on what's happening, include them in activities, and take great care of them. Thank you, Mr. Pet!! 100% recommended.
The place is fine. But the service isn't very good.

Do NOT let the negative reviews on here deter you from how great this place really is. It’s obvious all of the bad reviews are competitors trying to weigh them down.

They took care of my dog for 6 days and they sent me 4-6 videos a day, always communicated his well being, and they did a good job of handling him since he’s a small dog who doesn’t particularly get along with other dogs.

My experience at Mr. Pet was incredible! I left my dog ​​there for a week and she came back super happy!
From the moment I asked for information until I went to pick up my dog, everything was perfect. They kept me informed about everything and the staff was very friendly!

I thought it was a trustworthy place, but it wasn't. I left my dog ​​there for two days, and he came back with injured hind paws. The vet told me some chemical or chlorine had burned his paws. They never told me what happened or how it happened. According to them, he was fine.
Exceptional experience at Mr. Pet! I left my pet, Muu, at this dog hotel for a few days and I'm beyond satisfied with the service. ✨💖 …
